derivation: (BPW/8 bytes per weight) / 819e9 B/s * 1e15 fs/s. Model-independent: active-weight count cancels.
full_form: fs_per_weight = 152.63 * BPW / efficiency, where efficiency = achieved_bandwidth / peak
REQUIREMENT_FOR_SUB_100_FS: BPW < 0.6552 AND bandwidth efficiency near 1.0. BOTH are mandatory; neither alone suffices. Fixing occupancy alone takes Q80 to 212.53 fs, not below 100.
sparsity_is_neutral: Halving active weights halves token_ns AND the denominator, leaving fs/weight UNCHANGED. Active-parameter reduction raises TPS but does not move fs/weight-served. Do not spend on it expecting this metric to improve.
no_kernel_trick_escapes_the_floor: At batch=1 a decode matvec touches every active weight EXACTLY ONCE - arithmetic intensity ~1 flop/byte, zero reuse to amortize the read. This is why only BPW and efficiency appear, and why every topology/fusion attack failed on both models while every occupancy fix won: fusion cannot create reuse that does not exist.
precedent_for_sub_bit: Activation-aware sub-bit reached 0.167 BPW at 0.755 cosine on REAL activations for GLM (every prior sub-bit negative was a Gaussian-proxy artifact). 0.167 BPW = 25.5 fs/weight floor. But 0.755 cosine is low and Q30 at <=1.5 failed coherence, so the binding constraint is CAPABILITY, not bits.
label: AMORTIZED THROUGHPUT METRIC - NOT PHYSICAL SINGLE-WEIGHT LATENCY
